INT. CHANDLER'S CABIN - DAY

Chandler Riggs, our charming and mischievous protagonist, stands in his cozy cabin's kitchen. He's got a lean, athletic physique, with a mop of curly brown hair that frames his boyish face. His eyes twinkle with excitement as he prepares for his unique fishing expedition.

CHANDLER
(whispering to himself)
Time to catch dinner the Chandler way!

He strips down to his birthday suit, revealing a pert, peachy derrière that would make a sculptor weep with joy. His skin is sun-kissed, and his body is adorned with a few freckles, giving him an endearing, youthful appearance.

EXT. RIVERBANK - DAY

Chandler, now fully nude, wades into the river, his bare feet sinking into the soft, muddy riverbed. The water reaches his thighs, and he lets out a satisfied sigh. He looks around, ensuring no one's watching, then grins mischievously.

CHANDLER
(whispering to the fish)
Here, fishy, fishy...

He takes a deep breath, then lets out a long, loud, and unapologetic FART. The water around him bubbles and froths, and a cloud of butt stench spreads underwater. Suddenly, fish start floating to the surface, their little fish noses scrunched up in disgust.

Chandler, delighted, starts collecting the fish, placing them in a net he's brought along. He dances around, enjoying the relief and the success of his unconventional fishing method. His butt cheeks jiggle with each step, adding to the comedic scene.

EXT. CHANDLER'S CABIN - LATER

Back at the cabin, Chandler, now dressed, prepares a gourmet dinner. He fillets the fish with the precision of a seasoned chef, then seasons them with a blend of herbs and spices. He sizzles the fish in a pan, the aroma of cooked fish and herbs filling the air.

INT. CHANDLER'S CABIN - DINING AREA - NIGHT

Chandler sits down to enjoy his meal, a satisfied smile on his face. He takes a bite, savoring the flavors, then raises his glass in a toast.

CHANDLER
(toasting)
To the power of a good fart!

He chuckles to himself, enjoying his delicious, albeit unconventional, dinner.

FADE OUT.
